name: runspec
description: Executable enterprise application builder for production-ready systems.

scripts.verify:markdown: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js verify-markdown
scripts.verify:blueprint: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js verify-blueprint
scripts.blueprint:print: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js blueprint-print
scripts.agent:next: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js agent-next
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/test/*.test.js dist/test/generators/*.test.js && node dist/src/cli.js verify-markdown && node dist/src/cli.js verify-blueprint
